desc: 五色五档阻力阶梯一目了然，天然乳胶亲肤耐用，一袋装下全身训练
name: 五档环形弹力阻力带款

shots.intent: 首屏定调：五档色阶加收纳袋一图看全，一套够用的价值感
把五色翻译成可读进阶体系：点数即档位，入门到高阶一眼可循
先扎痛点：卷边断裂、刺鼻异味、勒肤刺激三格横排
本品与普通带六项对照，材质工艺完成信任闭环
陈列经典五色、粉系五档、三色装、六色装家族，暗示人群广度
深蹲示范蓝带环绕大腿的标准用法，给出看得见的训练结果
坐姿延展与俯撑套臂双动作合并，证明一条带练全身
微距呈现天然乳胶哑光质感与回弹，坐实亲肤信任
一手可握随时开练的便携召唤，完成临门一脚

style.backgroundSystem: product shots always seamless pure white #FFFFFF; comparison boards royal blue #2E86C1 panels versus light gray #D5D8DC panels; scenes bright home or outdoor daylight with calm neutral surfaces
style.direction: clean studio-driven fitness suite: white flat-lay skeleton, natural-light training scenes, blue-gray comparison boards; the five-color resistance ladder is the visual spine
style.iconSystem: thin single-color line icons; filled-dot count (1-5) as the level language; left-win right-lose comparison rows
style.lightingSystem: even shadowless top softbox for flat lays; natural diffused daylight for scenes; side-backlight for latex texture macros
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: a clean, studio-driven fitness suite for a five-piece latex loop resistance band set. Hero, detail and variant shots are flat lays on seamless pure white #FFFFFF under even shadowless top softbox light; the five bands - green #8DC63F, blue #2E6DA8, yellow #F2C230, red #D5302F, black #1C1C1C - always appear together as a resistance ladder in a fixed color order, and the filled-dot count from one to five is the recurring level language. Comparison and pain boards use a strict two-column system: royal blue #2E86C1 winning panels with white copy, light gray #D5D8DC losing panels with dark copy, thin line icons, no photographic clutter and no competitor branding. Lifestyle scenes use natural diffused daylight in bright home settings with a single saturated band as the only color focal point against low-saturation outfits. Bold geometric sans headlines, one short headline plus one support line per image, matte latex texture with a gentle natural curl. No brand marks, no neon gradients, no moody dark tones, no extra hues, no pull-up or tube-band forms.
noDrift: no neon gradients or heavy filters
no brand marks, URLs or level words
no pull-up or tube-band forms in frame
no changed color order or dot rules
style.presentationRules: five bands always appear together in fixed order green-blue-yellow-red-black with dot counts 1-5; the band is the only saturated focal point in scenes against low-saturation outfits; whitespace 25-40%
style.surfaceSystem: floating flat-lay with no visible table edge; matte latex bands with a gentle natural curl at the ends; wood floor and yoga mat in scenes
style.temperature: neutral-cool studio plus natural daylight warmth in scenes
style.typography: bold geometric sans-serif headlines with light sans body, one headline plus one support line per image
